description: In local politics, character matters. So does a candidate’s record of showing up—not just during an election, but year after year as a member of the community. Bill Muto has demonstrated both.For many years, I have known Bill through Warwick’s community and schools, and what consistently stands out is the way he conducts himself. He listens before he speaks. He treats people with honesty and respect. Most importantly, he genuinely cares about Warwick and the people who call our city home.Bill’s
